baseText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
text: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

baseText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
text: After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.

baseText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
text: It’s grown to resemble a skyscraper. Parts of its towering body glow due to a profusion of energy.

baseText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
text: People call it the embodiment of rage. It’s said that this Pokémon’s terrifying expression and shout will rid the world of malevolence.

baseText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
text: As it waits for the right moment to unleash its Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a perfect one-legged stance. It won’t even twitch.

baseText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
text: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon’s spiciness. It swings its “necktie” around to wallop its foes.

baseText: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
text: Glimmora’s petals—now larger and separated from its main body—rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.

baseText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
text: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.

baseText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
text: It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.

baseText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
text: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom—even through the air.

baseText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
text: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

baseText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
text: Its hind feet are webbed, so it's a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.

baseText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

baseText: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.
text: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

baseText: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

baseText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

baseText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

baseText: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
text: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

baseText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
text: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

baseText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

baseText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
text: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

baseText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
text: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.
